sql: SELECT `song_id` FROM `songs` AS `Song` WHERE `Song`.`song_id` = 1 AND `Song`.`status` = 'approved' AND `Song`.`is_visible` = true;

SELECT n.*, s.title AS seed_title, r.algorithm_version
    FROM recommendation_state st
    STRAIGHT_JOIN recommendation_runs r ON r.run_id=st.active_run_id
    STRAIGHT_JOIN recommendation_neighbors n FORCE INDEX (ix_neighbor_rank)
      ON n.run_id=r.run_id AND n.seed_id IN (1)
    STRAIGHT_JOIN songs s ON s.song_id=n.seed_id AND s.status='approved' AND s.is_visible=1
    STRAIGHT_JOIN songs c ON c.song_id=n.song_id AND c.status='approved' AND c.is_visible=1
    WHERE st.id=1
    ORDER BY n.seed_id, n.final_score DESC, n.song_id ASC

SELECT `Song`.`song_id`, `Song`.`title`, `Song`.`duration`, `Song`.`audio_url`, `Song`.`image_url`, `Song`.`view_count`, `artists`.`artist_id` AS `artists.artist_id`, `artists`.`name` AS `artists.name`, `genres`.`genre_id` AS `genres.genre_id`, `genres`.`name` AS `genres.name` FROM `songs` AS `Song` LEFT OUTER JOIN ( `song_artists` AS `artists->SongArtist` INNER JOIN `artists` AS `artists` ON `artists`.`artist_id` = `artists->SongArtist`.`artist_id`) ON `Song`.`song_id` = `artists->SongArtist`.`song_id` LEFT OUTER JOIN ( `song_genres` AS `genres->SongGenre` INNER JOIN `genres` AS `genres` ON `genres`.`genre_id` = `genres->SongGenre`.`genre_id`) ON `Song`.`song_id` = `genres->SongGenre`.`song_id` WHERE `Song`.`song_id` IN (13, 25, 5, 9, 17, 21, 4, 7, 10, 16, 19, 22, 2, 3, 6, 8, 11, 12, 14, 15, 18, 20, 23, 24) AND `Song`.`status` = 'approved' AND `Song`.`is_visible` = true;
